/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import Levenshtein, json
human=''
ens=json.load(open('ensembl_segments.json'))
segments={
'pan_troglodytes':ens['pan_troglodytes']['segment'],
'macaca_mulatta':ens['macaca_mulatta']['segment'],
'pan_paniscus':ens['pan_paniscus']['segment'],
'indri_indri':'',
'semnopithecus_johnii':'',
'ailuropoda_melanoleuca':ens['ailuropoda_melanoleuca']['segment'],
'delphinapterus_leucas':ens['delphinapterus_leucas']['segment'],
}
for sp in ['pan_troglodytes','macaca_mulatta','pan_paniscus','indri_indri','semnopithecus_johnii','ailuropoda_melanoleuca','delphinapterus_leucas']:
 print(sp,Levenshtein.distance(segments[sp],human))
PY"
